reason: My regulars come for me and my staff, not for points, and I already reach them on Instagram every Thursday. Putting a QR on the table of a wine bar where the waiter brings the bill and chats feels like turning us into a chain, even if the first three months are free.
objection: Will my guests really pay by QR instead of handing over a card or cash? At an upscale table the bill moment is part of the service, and on top of that I'd have strangers rating each dish and a payment fee stacked on what I already pay my bank.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a respected independent place in Sololaki or Vake where guests actually use the QR to pay and the owner says it sped up turnover on busy weekends without making service feel cold.
